name: league_snapshots
sql:
CREATE TABLE league_snapshots (
        snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

name: recommendations
sql:
CREATE TABLE recommendations (
        recommendation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        team_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        type TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT
      )

name: decision_audits
sql:
CREATE TABLE decision_audits (
        audit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        recommendation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

name: projections
sql:
CREATE TABLE projections (
        projection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        player_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source TEXT NOT NULL,
        scoring_period TEXT NOT NULL,
        league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT
      )

name: pmt_runtime_migrations
sql: CREATE TABLE pmt_runtime_migrations(migration_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

name: latest_snapshots
sql:
CREATE TABLE latest_snapshots (
      league_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES league_snapshots(snapshot_id)
    )

name: pmt_schema_migrations
sql:
CREATE TABLE pmt_schema_migrations (
      version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: actions
sql:
CREATE TABLE actions (
      action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      status TEXT NOT NULL,
      data TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: action_receipts
sql:
CREATE TABLE action_receipts (
      action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL,
      data TEXT NOT NULL,
      recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: audit_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
      audit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      data TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: job_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE job_runs (
      job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      dedupe_key TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL,
      available_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      lease_owner TEXT,
      lease_expires_at TEXT,
      attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      data TEXT NOT NULL,
      result TEXT,
      last_error TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(job_type, dedupe_key)
    )

name: scoped_projections
sql:
CREATE TABLE scoped_projections (
      scoped_projection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      projection_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      league_external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      scoring_period TEXT NOT NULL,
      data TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: v1_news
sql:
CREATE TABLE v1_news (
        news_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        player_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        league_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        published_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

name: v1_history
sql:
CREATE TABLE v1_history (
        record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        captured_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

name: v1_manager_profiles
sql:
CREATE TABLE v1_manager_profiles (
        manager_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

name: v1_notifications
sql:
CREATE TABLE v1_notifications (
        notification_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        league_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        data TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
